name: LLM-Stakeholders Interactive Negotiation Benchmark
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' communication and decision-making abilities in multi-agent negotiation scenarios involving cooperation, competition, and manipulation. It features complex multi-agent, multi-issue, and semantically rich negotiation games requiring arithmetic, inference, exploration, and planning in dynamic multi-turn setups.
reputation: Benchmark is highly challenging; GPT-3.5 and smaller models mostly fail, GPT-4 and SoTA large models still underperform.
notes: Includes procedures to create new games and increase difficulty; evaluates safety aspects such as interaction dynamics with greedy and adversarial players.

institutions: CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security
